title: Glycine-HCl Buffer Preparation
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfybjpsn

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M glycine solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 7.5 g of glycine (MW 75.0 g mol⁻¹) per litre of deionized water to make a 0.1 M glycine solution.

steps.title: Mix glycine with HCl
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 mL of the 0.1 M glycine solution to a beaker and add the indicated volume of 0.1 M hydrochloric acid to obtain a pH between 2.2 and 3.6; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Bring the mixture to a final volume of 100 mL with deionized water.

steps.title: Fine‑tune pH
steps.instruction: Measure the pH with a calibrated sensitive pH meter and, if necessary, adjust to the desired pH (2.2–3.6).
